def solution():
    # Define variables
    loan_amount = 300000
    loan_term_years = 30
    original_rate = 0.045
    new_rate = 0.04
    float_down_fee_percent = 0.4

    # Calculate monthly interest rates and total number of payments
    original_monthly_rate = original_rate / 12
    new_monthly_rate = new_rate / 12
    total_payments = loan_term_years * 12

    # Calculate monthly mortgage payments
    original_payment = (
        loan_amount * original_monthly_rate
        / (1 - (1 + original_monthly_rate) ** -total_payments)
    )
    new_payment = (
        loan_amount * new_monthly_rate
        / (1 - (1 + new_monthly_rate) ** -total_payments)
    )

    # Calculate total payment savings and subtract the float down fee
    total_payment_savings = (original_payment - new_payment) * total_payments
    float_down_fee = loan_amount * (float_down_fee_percent / 100)
    net_savings = total_payment_savings - float_down_fee

    # Return savings rounded to the nearest dollar
    return round(net_savings)
